attempts.text:
**The anchor sits alone in every chromosome.** Column 0, `acpP`, is the window's one spine column: carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names it in 100% of calls with 0.00 bits.

**Then 79 fork and variable columns open up.** Columns 1 to 79 are in a region of plasticity in 0 to 69% of calls, and the model names 66 to 100% of genes there, 94% on average. A second branch of 26 families runs through columns 1 to 26, carried by 10% of chromosomes, persistent: `fabF` to `cobB`. The `flg` genes, [[flagellar basal body and hook assembly]], fill columns 10 to 23, each in 88 to 90% of chromosomes.

**The middle is variable but predictable.** Columns 31 to 59, `pyrC` to `ghrA`, are variable, carried by 83 to 90% of chromosomes, all persistent. The `mdo` and `csg` genes there, [[glucan and curli biosynthesis]], keep the model steady. Hesitation peaks at column 60, `ycdU`, 1.83 bits, in a region of plasticity in 59% of calls, where the model names only 66%.

**The window ends in shell and persistent forks.** Columns 60 to 66 carry `ycdU`, an IS3 family transposase, `dgcT` and the `pga` genes, [[poly-beta-1,6 N-acetyl-D-glucosamine export]], shell families in 33 to 48% of chromosomes. Then `phoH` to `rutE`, columns 67 to 79, persistent in 58 to 68%, with `rutB` to `rutE` [[pyrimidine utilization]]. A second branch of 4 families sits at columns 65 to 68, carried by 13% of chromosomes, shell.

**Across the window the model is confident, less so in plasticity.** It names 95% of genes at 0.34 bits, perplexity 1.4 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.60 against 0.16 bits, and names fewer genes, 71% against 98%.

label: acpP
facts:
WINDOW: the acpP window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor acpP, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,600 to 2,679 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying acpP once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 95% of genes, 0.34 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,094 calls, named 99%, 0.14 bits; shell 5,749 calls, named 70%, 1.37 bits; cloud 357 calls, named 21%, 4.49 bits. Outside an RGP 37,749 calls, named 98%, 0.16 bits; inside an RGP 5,451 calls, named 71%, 1.60 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 41 fork, 38 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.60 against 0.16 bits) and names fewer genes (71% against 98%); 5,451 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 60 (ycdU) 1.83 bits, RGP 59%; column 61 ("IS3 family transposase") 1.28 bits, RGP 66%; column 62 (dgcT) 0.95 bits, RGP 69%. The 7 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 83%, 0.97 bits on average; the other 73 columns: named 96%, 0.28 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0-69%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: acpP. named 100%; 0.00 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0-69%. named 66-100% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 60, named 66%, 1.83 bits.
   a second branch of 26 families through columns 1-26, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10%, all P; the branch's families: fabF, pabC, yceG, tmk, holB, ycfH, ptsG, fhuE, hinT, ycfL, lpoB, thiK, nagZ, ycfP, ndh, ycfJ, comR, bhsA, ldtC, mfd, ycfT, lolC, lolD, lolE, nagK, cobB

   a second branch of 4 families through columns 76-79, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 13-24%, all P; the branch's families: ymdF, wrbA, yccJ, agp
